fusions.name: Drover's Blow
fusions.desc: A heavy blow that deals 28 damage and leaves the target [Bruised] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. When it hits, every ally near you deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Herd Tramp
fusions.desc: Stamps the ground, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Bellwether's Call
fusions.desc: A challenge that pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Grazing Count
fusions.desc: Every blow you land builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6, they all spend at once and heal you for 5% of your maximum health per stack.
